verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no user-overridable low-level engine settings such as memory locking (mlock) or mmap behavior. SSD expert streaming is described as built-in engine behavior, not a configurable setting. The only documented flags (--no-prerouter, --no-lora, --max-new) toggle adapters or cap output length, which are adjacent controls rather than memory or engine overrides.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
